<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 12"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Dashing Strike](/Feats.aspx?ID=4833) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fighter" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=601" />
<trait label="Press" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=133" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 149

**Requirements**
You are adjacent to an enemy

</column>

---

Springing away from one foe, you Strike at another. Stride up to your Speed, but you must end that movement within melee reach of a different enemy. At the end of your movement, make a melee Strike against an enemy now within reach. You can use Dashing Strike while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.
name: Dashing Strike
requirement: You are adjacent to an enemy
